controls.name: literal_exact_target_present
controls.meaning: The literal Q7 target is present; neighboring real-form uniformization is a separate question.

controls.name: frozen_candidate_identity
controls.meaning: Hash binds the compared candidate, not novelty.

controls.name: received_survey_primary_byte_identity
controls.meaning: Raw shared primary bytes independently bound; no root assessment is an input.

controls.name: reject_2018_as_2020_proposition_8_1
controls.meaning: Actual 2018 text cannot serve as the later sphere proposition and proof.

controls.name: reject_wrong_format_fv2020_publisher_response.pdf
controls.meaning: An HTTP 200 response with a .pdf suffix is not evidence of publisher PDF possession.

controls.name: reject_wrong_format_survey_hal_file.pdf
controls.meaning: An HTTP 200 response with a .pdf suffix is not evidence of publisher PDF possession.

controls.name: reject_wrong_format_surgeries_published.pdf
controls.meaning: An HTTP 200 response with a .pdf suffix is not evidence of publisher PDF possession.

controls.name: distinct_v1_and_v2_reduction_bytes
controls.meaning: Actual v1 and v2 bytes differ; no version identity is inferred.

controls.name: reject_single_byte_source_mutation
controls.meaning: Tampered bytes fail the identity comparison. No mathematical claim is thereby tested.

controls.name: earliest_dj_three_dimensional_surjectivity_note
controls.meaning: The note is present in the 2006 primary variant, not merely in a later publication.

controls.name: frame_target_pi1_order
controls.meaning: Own low-homotopy deduction from determinant weights: frame target is not simply connected.

controls.name: reject_plain_koshkin_on_frame_target
controls.meaning: Koshkin Theorem 3 assumptions cannot be discarded when substituting the frame target.

controls.name: accept_koshkin_underlying_flag_scope
controls.meaning: Underlying flag-map classification is within the prior theorem; derivative data is additional.

controls.name: reject_metadata_only_novelty_certificate
controls.meaning: Actual classifier control: neither model nor author identity supplies the required primary antecedent assessment.

controls.name: reject_negative_search_only_novelty_certificate
controls.meaning: Actual classifier control: negative search results cannot certify novelty.

controls.name: positive_prior_solution_control
controls.meaning: If an exact primary antecedent is actually read and established, the verdict must change. This is a control, not an assertion that one was found.

limits: Scope gates depend on independently recorded primary readings. The program detects specific invalid substitutions, not every possible equivalent predecessor.
